integrity: Analytic proof with independent symbolic Gaussian moment reconstruction and direct high-precision defining-integral checks. No independent review or external proof certification is claimed.
limitations: One real, positive amplitude ratio for a fixed pure two-Hermite superposition. The logarithmic negativity law does not give a full prefactor expansion. An equivalent earlier optical formulation cannot be definitively excluded.
title: A sharp two-circle junction in the Wigner nodal topology of a two-Hermite superposition
